Get CBA Player Box

Source: R/cba.R
cba_player_box.Rd

Player box score of a finished game, both sides, plus a team rebounds/turnovers row per side (null player_id).

Endpoint: POST https://data-server.cbaleague.com/api/player-match-datas/data-count (JSON body)

Usage

cba_player_box(schedule_id)

Arguments

schedule_id

(required) Required. CBA game id (integer), the global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx (100105799 = 2025-26 round 1). Only a finished game is served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: One row per player and a team rebounds/turnovers row per side (null player_id). An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sdv-py cba_player_box):

col_nametypedescription
schedule_idintegerCBA game id (key space: CBA games, ONE global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx across seasons and match types; the {scheduleId} of every game route). Stamped by the runtime from the request; null on a body parsed without it.
sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: home (the API's host / home block) or away (guest / visiting block).
assistsintegerAssists in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
blockedintegerBlocks in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
cn_aliascharacterPlayer name (Chinese). The team row reads 'team rebounds / turnovers' (rebounds and turnovers not credited to a player; that row does not exist in the 2009-10 sample).
field_goalsintegerField goals made in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
field_goals_attemptedintegerField goals attempted in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
field_goals_percentagedoubleField-goal percentage as a FRACTION 0-1 (0.308), null when no attempt (0/0) as well as on the team row.
foulsintegerPersonal fouls in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
free_throwsintegerFree throws made in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
free_throws_attemptedintegerFree throws attempted in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
free_throws_percentagedoubleFree-throw percentage as a FRACTION 0-1, null on the team row.
game_startintegerStarter flag: 1 = started the game. Null on the team row.
numbercharacterJersey number as a string. Null on the team row.
player_idintegerplayerId (key space: CBA persons, stable across seasons and clubs; 3-9 digits, older players have short ids (393433) and newer ones 100xxxxxx). Joins the player box routes, the season player lists and getPlayersByScheduleId. Not a team id. Null on the team row.
plus_minusintegerPlus-minus while on court. Null on the team row and on every row of the 2009-10 sample (not tracked then).
pointsintegerPoints in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
reboundsintegerTotal rebounds in this game (integer). The team row carries the team's own total here.
rebounds_defensiveintegerDefensive rebounds in this game (integer). The team row carries the team's own total here.
rebounds_offensiveintegerOffensive rebounds in this game (integer). The team row carries the team's own total here.
stealsintegerSteals in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
three_point_attemptedintegerThree-pointers attempted in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
three_point_goalsintegerThree-pointers made in this game (integer). Null on the team row (the (Chinese text) rebounds/turnovers row).
three_point_percentagedoubleThree-point percentage as a FRACTION 0-1, null on the team row.
turnoversintegerTurnovers in this game (integer). The team row carries the team's own total here.
up_timeintegerTime on court in SECONDS (1692 = 28:12). Null on the team row.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the routes that cbaleague.com's own data site (a Vue single-page app) calls. SportsDataverse has not ruled on the site's terms, so payloads are not redistributed as release assets. Requests are spaced at least 1 s apart per host; keep use small.

  • Access: every response body is AES-128-ECB encrypted with a public key shipped in the site's front-end bundle; the runtime decrypts it with digest::AES() (digest is a suggested package: install it to use these wrappers) and refuses anything that does not decrypt. The host blocks datacenter IPs at TCP: set the environment variable CBA_PROXY (or options(hoopR.proxy = ...)) to a residential proxy URL; it is never printed or put in a condition. Without a proxy the request goes direct and, from a datacenter, fails within seconds (a 5 s connect timeout, no retry of a refused or timed-out connect). Where direct access works (a residential IP), set CBA_DIRECT=1 for the full 60 s timeout and retries.

  • Seasons: the API's season is the START year; every season argument here is the END year (2026 = 2025-26) and is sent as season - 1. Columns named season keep the wire value (the START year, so the sdv END year is season + 1). The season list reaches 1995-96; box data before 2009-10 is unverified.

  • Coverage: game wrappers serve FINISHED games only. Each first reads the game report header (cached per session), and an unfinished game raises hoopR_asset_fetch. Box, period, roster and best-player bodies are checked against that header (points sum to the score, team ids match, advanced rows are box players). Play-by-play is served one period per request: every period is fetched, and a partial set, an unordered clock or a final score the plays do not reach is refused. Play-by-play is verified on 2017-18 and 2025-26 only and is absent for 2009-10 (hoopR_no_data). There are NO shot x/y coordinates in this API (shot location exists only as team and player zone splits), and play-by-play has no player or team ids (Chinese sentence text plus surnames). Box data has 12-minute quarters in 2009-10 and 2017-18 and 10-minute quarters in 2025-26. The women's CBA is not covered (no official source).

  • Not game data: cba_game_team_shots() and cba_game_team_four() answer the two teams' SEASON tables (the shot zones are the teams' current profile; the four factors are the previous season), whichever game is asked for. The reference lists (cba_team_options(), cba_team_counts()) and cba_report_status() are not echoed by the API, so their scope is unchecked.

  • Duplicate rows: in some games (2025-26 game 100105799) the advanced-box and extras routes repeat player rows (26 rows for 12 players), and the repeats are not always copies. cba_player_advanced() and cba_player_extras() keep the FIRST row per player_id.

  • Text fields are Chinese (names, play-by-play sentences, position and nationality labels). The column descriptions here are ASCII; sdv-py's tools/codegen/notes/cba_glossary.yaml holds the full English glossaries.

  • Personal data: the operator ids (createdBy / lastModifiedBy, one holds a mobile number) and any bare mobile-number string are removed from every body. Players' public bio fields (birth date, height, weight) are kept.

  • Ids: schedule_id (games, one global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx), team_id (clubs, stable across sponsor renames), player_id (persons) and match_type_id are integers. The roster registration id of cba_rosters() is a 19-digit integer that an R integer or double cannot hold exactly, so it is kept as its exact digits (character).

  • Errors are classed conditions: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a game without play-by-play), hoopR_bad_request (a non-integer id or season, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-200, including HTTP 500, which this API answers for a body it dislikes and which is not retried; a dead connection; an empty or undecryptable body; an unfinished game; a body for another game, team, season or day), all inheriting hoopR_error. HTTP 429 / 502 / 503 / 504 are retried, up to three attempts. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.

See also

Other CBA Functions: cba_best_player(), cba_best_stats(), cba_game_info(), cba_game_team_four(), cba_game_team_shots(), cba_match_types(), cba_pbp(), cba_period_scores(), cba_player_advanced(), cba_player_base(), cba_player_defensive(), cba_player_extras(), cba_player_offensive(), cba_player_shots(), cba_report_status(), cba_rosters(), cba_schedule_day(), cba_schedule_month(), cba_seasons(), cba_team_basic(), cba_team_counts(), cba_team_four(), cba_team_options(), cba_team_overview(), cba_team_shots(), cba_teams()
